title: Meeting Electricity Demand: Importance of Resource Balance and Choice
content: As dependence on electricity increases and technology advances, electric systems have become highly sophisticated, complex, integrated energy platforms. To meet growing demand, the electric grid requires a wide variety of diverse and strategically located resources and technologies. This includes fossil and renewable energy resources, as well as conservation and demand-side management solutions. Overdependence on any one resource can have devastating social and economic implications in times of resource scarcity.
author: Paul A. DeCotis
